meta.name: Failed to download
meta.title: Deadlock Mod Manager Failed to Download or Slow? Fixes
meta.description: Mods stuck on Failed to download or downloading slowly in Deadlock Mod Manager? Run the built-in connection check, wait out GameBanana rate limits, and fix antivirus, VPN and DNS problems.

hero.title: Mods failing to download, or downloading slowly
hero.intro: Deadlock Mod Manager downloads mods straight from GameBanana. When a download fails, it's GameBanana, your network, or something on your PC blocking the file. The app can tell you which.
hero.errorSource: Deadlock Mod Manager, on a mod card or in Downloads

messages.rateLimit: GameBanana rate limit reached / Too many requests (HTTP 429)
messages.refused: GameBanana refused automatic requests / Access denied (HTTP 403)
messages.writeFailed: Download failed: … (os error 5) / File write failed

diagnose.title: Start with the built-in check
diagnose.intro: Open Settings and click Diagnose connection. It tests your internet, DNS, our API and GameBanana one by one, and each failed check comes with a "How to fix" hint.

results.gameBananaFails: GameBanana fails, everything else passes: the problem is on GameBanana's side or between you and it. Wait, or turn off your VPN.
results.everythingFails: Everything fails: your connection, firewall or DNS is blocking the app. Allow Deadlock Mod Manager through your firewall and antivirus.
results.everythingPasses: Everything passes but downloads still fail: the file can't be saved. Check free disk space and the error message below.

rateLimit.fix: Wait for the retry time shown, then try again. Download mods a few at a time rather than queueing dozens at once.

unavailable.fix: GameBanana is down or overloaded. This often happens right after a Deadlock patch. Try again later; nothing on your side needs fixing.

refused.fix: GameBanana's protection is blocking your connection. Turn off any VPN or proxy and retry. If it persists, open the mod on GameBanana in your browser to check it loads.

network.fix: Your connection or DNS is failing. Run Diagnose connection, then try switching DNS to 1.1.1.1 or 8.8.8.8 and flushing it with ipconfig /flushdns.

writeFailed.fix: The file downloaded but couldn't be saved. Antivirus or folder permissions are blocking the app.

steps.readd: Cancel the download, remove the mod with its trash icon and add it again.
steps.vpn: Turn off VPNs, proxies and "download accelerator" tools while downloading.
steps.patchRush: Try again outside the rush right after a Deadlock patch, when GameBanana is busiest.
steps.status: Check <status>our status page</status>. If everything is up and it still fails, share your Diagnose connection results on <discord>Discord</discord>. The Copy results button puts them on your clipboard.

why.question: Why does Deadlock Mod Manager say Failed to download?
why.answer: Mods are downloaded straight from GameBanana. The download fails when GameBanana is down or rate-limiting you, when antivirus, a firewall or a VPN blocks the connection, or when the file can't be written to disk.

slow.question: Why are mod downloads so slow?
slow.answer: Download speed depends on GameBanana's file servers and the route between you and them. Large mods and busy hours after a Deadlock patch are slower. Turning off a VPN or proxy often helps; the app itself doesn't limit speed.

rateLimit.question: What does GameBanana rate limit reached mean?
rateLimit.answer: You sent too many requests in a short time, usually by downloading many mods at once. Wait for the number of seconds shown in the message, then retry.

down.question: Is Deadlock Mod Manager down?
down.answer: Check the status page at deadlockmods.app/status. If our services are up, use Diagnose connection in the app's Settings to see whether GameBanana or your network is the problem.
